comment: Very biased readings. Class isn't that boring. However, he is a tough grader and you have a large amount of reading. Midterms and finals were really difficult. I would not recommend this class to anyone. I worked harder than ever to get a B+. One kid in our class got an A out of 17. Do not take this class if you care about grades.

Dr. Stedman is awesome.  If you generally do the reading, he explains things very well in class and is helpful outside the classroom as well.  His sense of humor is unmatched, especially in his use of violent (but memorable!) examples in class.  I would take every class he offered if I could.

One of the best professors I've had at the University of Richmond. I've had him for two 300 upper level classes and he assigns a lot of reading but only two papers and a final. Also extreemly HILARIOUS in class...really a great guy. All his final questions are essays that come from the reading, so do the reading!!!
Most vague man ever. Refuses to tell things how they are. Grades essays insanely hard, and tests even harder. Not worth it for three credits.

Don't take this class! Its a ton of work to do and boring as anything. All he does is go over the homework for the entire class, and then spends about ten minutes on the new lesson. Then he gives you a ton of new homework which he collects and grades. I took it to not take calc but his tests are harder than they need to be.
